_comment: Swarm configuration. Edited by ~/.serge/swarm.sh (via the /swarm command) and read by swarm-brief.sh (UserPromptSubmit, tells the LEAD how to fan out) and swarm-doctrine.sh (SubagentStart, gives each subagent its rules). Hand-editing is fine; it is plain JSON. Nothing here costs a token while `enabled` is false.
_max_agents: Most subagents to run at once. The lead is told this number; it is guidance to the model, not a hard cap the harness enforces. Free seats are rpm-limited and a wide fan-out is what trips Mistral's shared budget, so 3 is deliberate rather than timid.
_agents: Which agent types the doctrine is injected for. '*' = all. Otherwise a hook matcher regex, e.g. 'reviewer|security|test'. This is passed to settings.json's SubagentStart matcher semantics, which match on agent_type.
_doctrine_file: The mini-constitution each subagent receives. Edit it to change what the swarm believes. Keep it SHORT — it is prepended to every subagent's context, so its length is multiplied by the fan-out width.
_brief_lead: Whether the LEAD agent is also told it is in swarm mode (fan-out width, briefing rules). Turning this off leaves the doctrine in place for subagents but stops nudging the lead to parallelise.
